controls.assessment: Primitive own seven argument descriptors, Proxy rejection, bounded absolute canonical/control-free paths, exact score/replay and unique supplied paths.

Root/inputs FD-first NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK type/cap/identity checks; all four/five sizes and totals admitted before supplied Buffer allocation; positive short reads, overflow byte, same-FD and final all-file stability; ownership cleared before one close attempt.

Owned canonical 0700 directory FD; exclusive 0600 output with same-FD identity/nlink, positive bounded writes, file fsync/readback/stability, release-before-close, directory fsync/one close and final named checks; uncertain partial/full outputs retained without overwrite/unlink/chmod/retry.

Fixed unchanged actual scorer receives captured original Buffers and packets:null; score and full replay have fixed full fifteen-row scope/null unverified measurements. Encoded artifact and 4KiB stdout summary bounded before output; content digest and complete-file digest have distinct stated preimages; stable non-echoing errors.

Import-only command guard and real-file entry identity permit ordinary/owned symlink entry; bounded stdout/stderr and failure exit. No network, provider, collector, command retry or optional external packet adapter.

findings.problem: The exit observer uses captured high-level writeFileSync while fs open/write denial hooks remain installed. Capturing a convenience function does not establish that its internal fs calls bypass later patches; the proof writer is therefore not demonstrably independent of the denial being tested.
findings.nativeCorroboration: All five write-denial cases in the retained ROOT log fail the bounded-terminal assertion with ENOBUFS; later validation/no-write assertions were not reached.
findings.mechanismQualification: Wrapper/delegation root-cause remains source inference corroborated after the author failure cue, not an independently executed reproduction or a fully observed native observer stack.
findings.requiredNarrowCorrection: Use captured primitive open/write/fsync/close functions for a distinct private bounded exclusive observer proof, clear descriptor ownership before one close, and preserve the armed product write-denial controls and zero-write/cap assertions.

findings.problem: Test snapshots observe path bytes and mode via separate path operations; current captured CodeQL alerts 92-95 mark these test flows. They do not bind each snapshot to one admitted descriptor.
findings.requiredNarrowCorrection: Test-only FD-first regular/capped admission, same-FD bounded bytes and metadata/stability, one close, preserving all byte/mode/symlink assertions without suppression.
findings.scopeQualification: Captured alerts are in test snapshots; this is not a captured product runtime alert or proof of hostile exploitation.
